description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeDao class, which provides data access methods for theme entities within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It includes methods for saving themes, retrieving themes by name, deleting themes, and fetching theme images based on various parameters.

classes.name: ThemeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Theme entity, providing methods for CRUD operations and theme-related queries.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Persists a Theme object to the database.

methods.name: getThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a Theme entity by its name, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getPartialThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a PartialTheme DTO for a theme identified by name, selecting specific theme properties.

methods.name: deleteThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Deletes a theme from the database based on its name.

methods.name: getImageByImageKeyAndThemeName
methods.description: Fetches a ThemeImage DTO for a specific image key and theme, or null if not available.
